name: 3D Bresenham Voxel Traversal
aliases: Bresenham's Line Algorithm for Voxel Traversal
definition: An algorithm to determine the sequence of integer voxel coordinates (x, y, z) intersected by a line segment from (xi, yi, zi) to (xf, yf, zf). It iterates along the dominant axis and updates the other two axes based on accumulated error terms.
